name: eop-parser
description: Pure C++ Earth orientation parser emitting SDS $EOP records (typed contracts 1.0: FlatBuffers only, no JSON and no base64). Each method reads exactly one source: "response", the HttpResponse (HRSP) from hostcap/http-request (its CONTEXT the optional $ICN job from eop-request, whose DATASET_ID must name the method's format; 304 -> one FlowNotice Unchanged on "unchanged", any other non-200 fails), or "body", one $FIL whose CONTENT is the unmodified file (at most 16 MiB; MODIFIED_AT_MS, when set, is the issue epoch written to every row's DATA_SET_EPOCH). Outputs the size-prefixed $EOP stream on "records" and one IngestRequest (INGQ) on "meta": SCHEMA EOP.fbs, TAGS SOURCE_NAME the series name, SOURCE_URL, BATCH_ID the SHA-256 of the whole body; PROVENANCE SOURCE_SHA256, NORMALIZED_COUNT (rows), PARSER eop-parser, PARSER_VERSION the format, SCHEMAS/SCHEMA_COUNTS, WARNINGS (blank future finals rows skipped). Every row carries DATA_SET_CID (CIDv1 raw sha2-256, base16). Malformed input fails the whole invocation with no output. No hostcalls, no capabilities.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One $FIL: CONTENT the unmodified finals2000a file (at most 16 MiB), optional MODIFIED_AT_MS the issue epoch. Exclusive with response.

acceptedTypeSets.description: IngestRequest (INGQ): SCHEMA EOP.fbs, TAGS SOURCE_NAME (series name) / SOURCE_URL / BATCH_ID (body SHA-256), PROVENANCE (source SHA-256, row count, parser eop-parser + format, blank-row warnings).

outputPorts.description: IngestRequest (INGQ): SCHEMA EOP.fbs, TAGS SOURCE_NAME (series name) / SOURCE_URL / BATCH_ID (body SHA-256), PROVENANCE (source SHA-256, row count, parser eop-parser + format, blank-row warnings).
